chunks: And whatever is in it from Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Kūfī, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for a narrator
key_terms.عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ: from Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān; the named source of transmission in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; an explicit statement of transmission by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission chain in hadith literature and preserving the source lineage of the narrations.
